exposure: saline infusion sonogram (SIS) under high pressure (SIStreat)
saline infusion sonogram (SIS) under low pressure
cohort: 183 women recruited from the infertility outpatient Clinic of El-Shatby University Hospital, Alexandria, Egypt
finding: While there was no significant difference in tubal patency rates between HSG and SIStreat, the spontaneous pregnancy rate after 6 months was significantly higher in the SIStreat group.
